name: Ratio Tracking with Null Scattering
definition: A Monte Carlo method for solving the recursive integral equation for transmittance in participating media, using ratio tracking to sample distances proportional to the homogenized transmittance and distinguishing between real and fake particle interactions.
summary: Ratio tracking with null scattering is a Monte Carlo method that estimates transmittance by accumulating continuous null-scattering ratios, avoiding the high variance of binary visibility tests found in standard delta tracking.
